criteria.criterion: All candidates run the same representative workload with reproducible results.

carried_by.obligation: #38: the same scripted workload on every eligible non-Electron candidate, rerun so its results are reproducible

criteria.criterion: Chosen architecture handles four agent streams, three terminals, Monaco, and live Preview on minimum target hardware without UI starvation.

carried_by.obligation: #38: four concurrent agent streams, dispatched and supervised at once
#38: three active terminal tabs with bounded scrollback in real PTYs
#38: an editor with diffs, mapped back to the sources it opens
#38: a live integrated Preview of the run's own output

criteria.criterion: Cancellation kills child processes without orphan worktrees, ports, or secret-bearing processes.

carried_by.obligation: #38: cancellation of the whole process tree, then restart

elsewhere.why: the fixture creates no worktree, so no run of it can leave one behind; classifying and cleaning up cancelled, orphaned and still-referenced worktrees is M10's, which this record routes rather than restates
the fixture's terminal children carry no credential, so no run observes a secret-bearing process; accounting for descendants and outstanding privileged side effects at a hard stop is Q02's

criteria.criterion: Crash/restart recovers canonical state without transcript dependence.

carried_by.obligation: #38: crash and client reconnect that recover canonical state without the transcript

criteria.criterion: Platform-specific compromises and fallbacks are explicit.

carried_by.obligation: #38: Linux Wayland, Linux X11, Windows and macOS exercised as applicable, with platform-specific compromises and fallbacks recorded

criteria.criterion: Signed-build/update paths exist for every required desktop platform.

elsewhere.why: no candidate has a packaged, signed build or an update feed, and producing one is not a measurement this contract can take: Q12 owns signatures, notarization, installers, channels and the update path for every supported surface, and Q09 (#417) owns the Linux package and service integration

criteria.criterion: Desktop framework never owns canonical project/agent state.

carried_by.obligation: #38: the desktop framework holding no canonical project or agent state, evidenced by authorized headless work surviving shell exit

criteria.criterion: A headless Linux Host can be controlled by another desktop client before desktop feature implementation begins.

carried_by.obligation: #38: a second desktop client controlling a headless Linux Host, including controller handoff
